#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# CMake file for the generated C++ code for the robot Fancy
#
# Note: this file has been generated by RobCoGen.
#       Do not edit unless you know what you are doing.
#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Project configuration
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.12...3.22)
project(Fancy_robcogen)

set(LIB_NAME "fancyrcg2")

add_compile_definitions(EIGEN_NO_DEBUG)
add_compile_options(-std=c++11 -Wall -O3)
include_directories(.) # so that local includes with < > will also work


set(HEADERS
    ./declarations.h
    ./rbd_types.h
    ./traits.h
    ./transforms.h
    ./inertia_properties.h
    ./constants.h
    ./inverse_dynamics.h
    ./jsim.h
    ./forward_dynamics.h
)

set(SOURCES
    ./constants.cpp
    ./transforms.cpp
    ./inertia_properties.cpp
    ./inverse_dynamics.cpp
    ./jsim.cpp
    ./forward_dynamics.cpp
)

# Add library
add_library(${LIB_NAME} SHARED ${SOURCES})

# Install the shared library
install(TARGETS ${LIB_NAME} LIBRARY DESTINATION lib)

# Install (ie copy) header files
install(FILES ${HEADERS} DESTINATION include/fancy/rcg2/)


# The playground main()
add_executable(playground playground.cpp)
target_link_libraries(playground ${LIB_NAME})


# Tests
add_executable(test-id    tests/test_id.cpp)
add_executable(test-jsim  tests/test_jsim.cpp)
add_executable(test-fd    tests/test_fd.cpp)
add_executable(test-cons  tests/test_consistency.cpp)

target_link_libraries(test-id   ${LIB_NAME})
target_link_libraries(test-jsim ${LIB_NAME})
target_link_libraries(test-fd   ${LIB_NAME})
target_link_libraries(test-cons ${LIB_NAME})
